An unmatched [ in image alt text is escaped so the image survives

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<img alt=\"[A;B)\" src=\"S\">", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
